correctness.rationale: For every 14-bit word, prefix sums p_j determine exact multiplicities c_(l,r)=#{i:p_(i+l)-p_i=r} for every positive substring length l; equality of these integer count arrays is precisely full substring-Parikh multiset equicomposability. An independent complete enumeration of all 2^14=16384 words, using prefix-difference count vectors as exact tuple keys, recovered 128 one-word classes, 8104 two-word classes and 12 four-word classes, matching both packaged independent Python-window and C++-correlation algorithms and their twelve saved four-word fibers. Thus E14=4 and exactly 48 words are ambiguous beyond reversal; 48/16384=3/1024. There are exactly 2^7=128 length14 palindromes; because every non-palindrome has a distinct reversal partner, the 128 singleton classes are precisely palindromes. This is a mathematically exhaustive *finite* argument for n=14, not extrapolation to general lengths.
